Lina (Docs): Heads-up — seeing a mismatch between Netlify and Vercel previews for PR #2312. Netlify preview is 404ing hashed css/assets, Vercel shows everything. Can a reviewer take a quick look?
Maya: Ugh, that one blocks the migration guide screenshots. I can review but need the preview fixed first.
Tom: I can jump on it. Which branch + commit?
Lina (Docs): branch=docs/migration-update, commit=9f3b2d. Netlify preview link: https://deploy-preview-2312--redwood-docs.netlify.app (shows missing /assets/site.9f3b2d.css 404)
Jared: netlify-bot reports a cache mismatch earlier in the log: `asset hash mismatch detected during publish` — looks like artifact sharding.
netlify-bot: Build 2312 finished. Warnings: 1 asset upload retry. Detected differing artifact manifest between shard-1 and shard-2.
Yasir: Can you paste the build log lines? Sometimes `npm run build` produced a different filename locally because of NODE_ENV.
Lina (Docs): pasted logs: ``
Uploading artifact shard-1... ok
Uploading artifact shard-2... ok
Finalizing manifest... warning: duplicate entry for /assets/site.9f3b2d.css
Publish completed with warnings
``
Ola (Eng): This smells like concurrent preview builds hitting the same artifact storage name. Quick workaround: clear Netlify cache and trigger a single rebuild. Longer fix: make artifact names include build id.
Tom: For immediate unblock, try the local preview and confirm assets. Run: ``docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/docs -w /docs squidfunk/mkdocs-material mkdocs build && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000`` then open http://localhost:8000 to validate hashed assets.
Maya: I verified locally after Tom's suggestion — hashed CSS present. So Netlify is the odd one out.
Jared: Scheduled a Netlify cache clear and single rebuild. Pinged netlify-bot to re-deploy.
netlify-bot: Cache cleared for site redwood-docs. Triggering new deploy for PR 2312.
vercel-bot: Note — Vercel preview used separate artifact pipeline; no cache conflict detected.
Lina (Docs): Thanks. Assuming rebuild passes, do we want to merge during the staggered merge slot tonight (23:00 UTC) or wait for morning to avoid touching release windows?
Yasir: If all tests pass, merging during the midnight slot is fine. I'll be on-call and can watch the preview and quick smoke tests.
Ola (Eng): +1 for midnight slot to avoid release-day churn. If anything flakey, we can revert quickly.
Maya: I'll hold the review and approve once Netlify shows stable preview.
Tom: Deploy finished and preview looks good now — assets present. All link-checker jobs OK.
Maya: Approved.
Lina (Docs): Great — merging at 23:00 UTC. Leaving PR with `do-not-merge` removed and adding merge-note: "merge-window: midnight-slot; watch: Yasir". :thumbsup:
Jared: FYI for docs devs — if you hit this again, run `rm -rf .cache/netlify && npm run build` before pushing, and include `CI=true` in the build env for consistent hashes.
Lina (Docs): Noted. I'll add a short blurb to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md about local preview + Netlify cache dance.
Ola (Eng): Thanks everyone.
Lina (Docs): Closing thread after merge completes.
